3A.why: Paper Config A. Baseline. Paper: great per-device, but collapses all-in-one (recall 0.35-0.79) -> check whether it also collapses on your merged data.

3B.why: Paper Config B. Baseline. Same 6-neuron bottleneck, wider -> isolates the effect of width.

3C.why: LIGHTWEIGHT. Half the width of 3B, same bottleneck -> how much accuracy do we pay for a smaller FL payload?

3D.why: BOTTLENECK WIDTH. 3B with a 12-neuron code instead of 6 -> is the 6-neuron bottleneck too tight for merged multi-device traffic?
